_intro:
## Ready for fix sessions, in this order (checked by eye, 2026-11-02, kinds at noon and the first walkable cells)

1. **`shape` list below, one kit at a time.** The user's main ask. Checked at its top: `vendor-pretzel-cart` is a box on a plinth with two plain boxes on top, `prop-waterbutt` a 10-sided prism with a pie-slice lid, `veg-allotment-*` hexagon slabs, cones and paper-strip beans. Further down it's noisier: `feat-marketstall` ranks high for customers' hats, because the capture stands in the crowd. Read the "what" column before starting on a row.
2. **`vehicle-roof-open-top`.** A plain bug and probably small: the roof of an estate car reads as see-through, you look through it into the cabin at a black silhouette of a driver, and the roof rails float (`objects/veh-estate/12_1m`). Checked on the estate only; judges name the sedan too.
3. **`fittings-floating-unattached` and `thin-structures-unattached`.** Real, each a small fix, so work down the lines in `sweep-tag-bug.md`: the SEAVIEW HOTEL sign's poles run in front of the letters (`objects/named-seaview-hotel-59/12_roof`), lantern rods come in slanted from above the frame and stop in front of windows (`squares/c10_-130/12_N`), the DIRECTORY board hangs in the air inside a shop (`objects/cs-text-tenants/12_1m`).
4. **`textures-smeared-stretched`.** Mixed, so split it. Wrong materials are the real part: wood grain on the stone arch ring of the road tunnel (`objects/feat-roadportal/12_3m`), whose lights are also plain slabs.
5. **`decals-cracks-stains-pasted` and `sky-specks-dots`.** Checked under the first brief: black squiggle cracks on plaster and rock, white dots at noon.
6. **`people-mannequin-stiff-blank`, `objects-interpenetrate-geometry`, `hands-miss-held-objects`.** Real, large. Close up, hair pokes through hats and arms are stiff (`objects/ped-hat-sunhat/12_1m`). The capture exaggerates it by standing in the crowd. Interpenetrate and hands: judges' lines, not opened.

**Not opened by me:** `sign-lettering-clipped`, `objects-no-contact-shadow`, `vehicles-toy-like`, `architectural-details-crude`, `prop-count-misplaced`, and everything under `thought`.

**Hold:** `shadow-bands-no-caster`, because the one I opened (`squares/c-30_-90/12_N`) looks like real shadows of the facade above. `lighting-inconsistent-noon`, because some of it is the capture in deep forest (`objects/rail-regional-cab-car-head/12_1m` is a view into dark trees, not the train). `glass-flat-no-depth`, `foliage-flat-cards`, `ground-surfaces-flat`: until more walkable cells are judged; only about a fifth are so far.

**Not the city:** `camera-misses-subject` and `camera-clips-into-geometry` rank first and third, and are the capture tool framing badly. They mean those kinds weren't really seen.

**White wall, open but lower:** it turns white in hard-edged rectangles only when the camera is level within about 1° and the wall within about 1° of square-on. At 3° down, none of 12 shots shows it, and the walker starts 3° down, so 207 m with real keys didn't show it on either build. A walker who tilts to level would. Sheet: `shots/sweep-check/white-pitch/kioskd-5197.png`. Reproduce: `__city.view({target:{x:-31,y:1.6,z:-136},distance:3,yaw:180,pitch:0})` at noon, or a level walk east along z = 108.25, where a facade flashes for one frame at x ≈ −35 (`shots/sweep-motion-level5197/motion/e00020.jpg`). Cause not found. The pictures judged here stand 8° off, which avoids it; the 1,519 shot square-on were deleted and shot again.
